period_note: BASIS BREAK FROM THE MAIN SERIES: Consolidated only, continuing the pattern established from 2025 Q1 onward (no Separate/Bank-only statement set is printed) -- flagged per the project's Solo-preference rule. Income-statement items are for 1 January to 31 March 2026 (Q1-cumulative = Q1-discrete). EPS is plain 'Earnings per share (EPS)', not annualized. Source PDF (Creator/Producer 'RICOH MP 3555', the SAME photocopier model flagged in this bank's FY2024 annual-report research as producing pure image scans) is a genuine scan -- pdftotext extracted only the cover title and 3 stray note-reference numbers from an embedded partial text layer, 0 characters from any actual statement table -- so OCR (pdftoppm 250dpi + tesseract) was used as the legitimate last resort, per the task brief's guidance to expect scan/font issues in this bank's interim filings specifically. Unlike the 2016_Q3/2026_Q1 OCR risk of digit misreads, EVERY balance-sheet subtotal in this document was independently cross-verified by re-summing its own printed component lines (Cash, Balance with other banks, Investments, Loans and advances, Deposits and other accounts, Other liabilities/Total liabilities, Total shareholders' equity, Total assets) -- all matched their printed subtotal to within BDT 1 (rounding), and the full identity Total Liabilities 104,519,180,650 + Total Shareholders' Equity 9,016,827,464 = Total Assets 113,536,008,114 holds exactly, giving high confidence in the OCR despite the scan. The P&L was independently cross-validated a second way: this filing's own '01 January to 31 March 2025' comparative column reproduces this dataset's own 2025_Q1.json figures exactly line-for-line (Interest income 2,318,112,742, Net interest income 506,811,941, Total operating income 995,004,448, Net profit after tax 38,326,614, EPS 0.06 -- all matching), confirming both extractions (this OCR and the earlier direct pdftotext read of the 2025 Q1 filing) are accurate and that no restatement occurred for FY2025 Q1 between the two filings. Off_balance_sheet_exposures is 'calculated' rather than 'reported' here: the OCR's raw text for the printed 'Total off-Balance Sheet items including contingent liabilities' row was ambiguous/duplicated a nearby subtotal, so the value used (20,633,395,183) is computed as Total contingent liabilities (17,209,292,334, itself confirmed by summing Acceptances+Letters of guarantee+Irrevocable LC+Bills for collection exactly) plus Other commitments/Forward assets purchased (3,424,102,849, unchanged from 31-Dec-2025) -- the comparative-period sum using this same method (17,035,430,622 + 3,424,102,849 = 20,459,533,471) matches the OCR'd comparative total of 20,459,533,472 to within 1 taka, supporting the method. NOTABLE (turnaround from the FY2025 crisis, see 2025_Q2.json/2025_Q3.json): Net interest income is still negative (-18,551,132) but has improved sharply from Q1-2025's already-positive-by-comparison... note Q1-2025 alone (506,811,941) was actually positive; the deterioration was concentrated in Q2-Q3 2025 -- General provision is now a RELEASE (-143,404,313) and Total provision (D) is a net release of -18,327,617 (vs a 311,741,021 charge in Q1-2025), driving Net profit after tax back to positive 86,226,494 (EPS 0.12) from Q1-2025's 38,326,614 (EPS 0.06).
